mapper.select: SELECT la.loan_account_id, COALESCE((SELECT lsj.loan_judgment_status_id FROM loan_status_judgment lsj WHERE lsj.loan_account_id = la.loan_account_id ORDER BY lsj.loan_status_judgment_id DESC LIMIT 1), #{normal}) AS previous_judgment_status, lp.repayment_method_id, lc.contract_principal, lc.maturity_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repayment_schedule rs WHERE rs.loan_account_id = la.loan_account_id AND rs.repayment_schedule_status_id = #{overdue}) AS overdue_installment_count, (SELECT MIN(rs.scheduled_date) FROM repayment_schedule rs WHERE rs.loan_account_id = la.loan_account_id AND rs.repayment_schedule_status_id = #{overdue}) AS oldest_overdue_date FROM loan_account la JOIN loan_contract lc ON lc.loan_contract_id = la.loan_contract_id JOIN loan_product lp ON lp.loan_product_id = lc.loan_product_id WHERE la.loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_status_judgment (loan_account_id, business_date, loan_judgment_status_id) VALUES (#{loanAccountId}, #{businessDate}, #{status})
